open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator error precedence
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST normalize the supplied email and validate the supplied password through the existing staff identity input boundary, hash that password exactly as supplied through the credential boundary, build the account with StaffRole.ADMINISTRATOR, StaffStatus.ACTIVE, a set email_verified_at and created_by None, and its audit record with ActorKind.SYSTEM and no actor_id, key_version or project_id, AuditAction.STAFF_CREATE, AuditEntityKind.STAFF_ACCOUNT, AuditResult.SUCCESS and no reason_code, and hand both to the port in one call. It MUST NOT open a transaction, query persistence, or perform an authorization check, because no authorized administrator can exist yet.
open_points.other_text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise BootstrapAlreadyCompletedError, and never the input rejection, when the port reports an already initialized store, so a repeat attempt changes nothing and the caller can tell a second run apart from a mistyped address. IdentityInputRejected stays reserved for the supplied email and password. A genuine storage failure MUST propagate unchanged and MUST NOT be turned into either refusal. BootstrapAlreadyCompletedError is this module's own exception, defined here at top level as a plain Exception subclass whose body is pass and raised without arguments; it is not imported.
open_points.question: Must email/password validation occur before the only persistence call, or must an already initialized store take precedence even when those inputs are invalid; if completion must take precedence, how can it be determined without querying persistence or passing an unvalidated account to create_if_empty?

open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator storage exception handling
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST retain the supplied password only in hashed form and MUST NOT let that password or its hash reach standard output, standard error, a log, an audit record, a returned value or an exception message.
open_points.other_text: A genuine storage failure MUST propagate unchanged and MUST NOT be turned into either refusal.
open_points.question: If a storage failure's exception message contains the password hash from the StaffAccount passed to the port, must the exception be propagated unchanged or altered to prevent the hash from reaching an exception message?
